Businessman Arrested on Sexual Harassment Charges in Bengaluru

Businessman P.R. Sundar was arrested in Bengaluru on sexual harassment charges. A complaint was filed by a woman news anchor, and the FIR registered by Chennai Police includes charges of sexual harassment. Sundar denies the allegations, claiming the case is linked to a property dispute and that the complaint is malicious. Some reports also mention he is a stockbroker and has faced SEBI norm violations and written vulgar tweets. Separately, an Indian-origin landlord in Pennsylvania, US, is being sued by the US Justice Department and a tenant over alleged sexual harassment and retaliation.
